thread:
Maria Chen: quick thought — midflight resume: rather than opaque resume token, what if edge proxies emit a compact snapshot (KV pointers + last-k tokens) to an ephemeral store and hand a handle to the client? New gateway pulls the handle and continues. Pros: smaller on-wire, version checks. Cons: extra store ops, potential duped tokens.

Ajay Patel: interesting. how do we keep side-effect safety? function calls, webhooks, db writes — replaying could double-run.

Sam Torres: we need deterministic replay guards. attach a replay-seq + idempotency key to outgoing side-effecting operations. downstreams must dedupe based on that key.

Priya Nair: backpressure concern — can't block ingress while snapshot lands. my thought: async snapshot push with short TTL + optimistic accept. if new proxy fails to pull, fallback to full restart/retry.

Maria Chen: rough handshake sketch: 
```json
{
  "type": "snapshot_offer",
  "handle": "s3://ephemeral/abc123",
  "kvcache_version": "v5",
  "last_tokens": 24
}
```
New proxy flow: pull -> validate kvcache_version -> fast-attach -> resume. If validation mismatch -> graceful restart mode with best-effort prefix replay.

Sam Torres: :thinking_face: tracing & billing implications? spans should show continuity, and we must not bill tokens twice on a resume.

Maria Chen: plan: include parent trace-id in snapshot metadata. billing: tag snapshot with original request-id + resume-offset. billing pipeline dedupes by (request-id, resume-offset).

infra-bot: note: this increases ephemeral store ops. ops action: need low-latency regional object store or in-memory cache fallback. rollout: 2-phase (canary region -> global).

Ajay Patel: also keep a tiny local ring buffer (last ~64 tokens) to avoid hitting store for intra-node handoffs. cheap and fast.

Priya Nair: action items: I'll draft RFC + perf checklist. we need a microbenchmark: 1k handoffs/min with 50ms median store latency vs baseline. @Sam @Ajay can you run mocks?

Sam Torres: will run a profiler and mock store today. target: added p99 < 30ms for fast handoff path.

Maria Chen: thanks — i'll put these notes in the RFC and call out: idempotency contract, trace propagation, billing dedupe, ops latency SLOs. tl;dr: non-blocking snapshot+handle seems promising if ops and idempotency are nailed. :+1:
